== migrasyon down: a migration nothing can undo (exit 1)
migrasyon: 20260727T153000_one_way.sql: nothing here can undo it: operation 1 (raw): raw is irreversible: its effect is opaque to the framework; write the undo as a raw operation in Down -- and the whole rollback is refused before anything runs, because one that stopped at an operation with no inverse would leave a schema no migration describes
  next: author a down for this migration, or declare it irreversible with a reason; until then migrasyon down --to <its version> rolls back only what is newer

== migrasyon up: an operation the driver will not compile (exit 1)
migrasyon: 20260727T153000_add_users.sql: driver "fake" against server 0.0-fake will not perform 1 operation in this migration's up run,
so nothing in it ran and nothing was recorded for it:

  operation 1 (raw) on "CREATE TABLE users (id bigint);": this fake engine has no such thing

The declaration is resolved against the connected server rather than read from documentation
(invariant #13), so another server may answer differently.
  next: rewrite the operations above as ones this server performs, or run against a server that performs them; migrasyon validate --connect lists every such operation before anything runs

== migrasyon up: a migration edited after it was applied (exit 4)
migrasyon: 20260727T153000_add_users.sql: an applied migration has been edited since it was applied.
The source half of its checksum moved, and it is the only half drift is decided on:

  recorded   migrasyon1:1d622eff7b85bf754dc0f1f30202fd2565e2435631e24085442cb8ec52d3b1b9:312b5a7de385ca36602e16ed4dff4236c34959a50b62d32812df486265804ba4
             recorded 2026-07-27 15:30:00 UTC, batch 1 ordinal 1
  on disk    source 6f373f530419d62b30e1cc3e06a4d3478884be219974b2691bc34bcd2e980098

The recorded IR half is what that run emitted, and nothing here recomputes it: doing so
needs a language runtime and a live database, and a migration may branch on live query
results, so a mismatch there would not be drift.

No flag rewrites a recorded checksum (invariant #6), and this run stopped before its
first statement.
  next: restore the file to the bytes that were applied, from version control, and make the change in a new migration with migrasyon create

== migrasyon up: a database left between states (exit 1)
migrasyon: 20260727T153000_add_users.sql: this migration's last run left the schema between states.

  applied      statement 1 of the up run, and nothing rolled them back
  stopped by   the server refused this statement
  not applied  whatever that run had left after statement 1 -- the row records how far it got,
               not how far it had to go, and nothing here recomputes that: the statements were
               the ones that run emitted, and a migration may branch on live query results
               
  recorded     batch 1, ordinal 1, at 2026-07-27 15:30:00 UTC

Neither up nor down runs against this database until the dirty state is resolved explicitly, and
nothing here undoes it -- nothing here knows what the statement that failed left behind. migrasyon
status and migrasyon history print this row without failing.
  next: run migrasyon resolve --resume to go on from statement 1, or record what you did yourself with migrasyon resolve --applied or --rolled-back --reason <why>
